question:
A trading company specializes in wholesale business of a certain kind of miscellaneous grain. The company has a warehouse with a capacity of 5000 units. On January 1st, the company has a stock of 1000 units of miscellaneous grain and a capital of 20000 yuan. The estimated prices of the grain for the first quarter are shown in Table 1-8.
Table $1-8$
\begin{tabular}{c|c|c}
\hline Month & Purchase Price/(yuan/unit) & Selling Price $/$ (yuan $/$ unit) \\
\hline 1 & 2.85 & 3.10 \\
2 & 3.05 & 3.25 \\
3 & 2.90 & 2.95 \\
\hline
\end{tabular}

The purchased grain arrives in the same month but can only be sold in the following month, and it is required to be paid upon delivery. The company wants to have a stock of 2000 units at the end of the quarter. What buying and selling strategies should be adopted to maximize the total profit over the three months?

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "months": [1, 2, 3],
    "purchase_price": {1: 2.85, 2: 3.05, 3: 2.90},
    "selling_price": {1: 3.10, 2: 3.25, 3: 2.95},
    "capacity": 5000,
    "initial_stock": 1000,
    "initial_cash": 20000,
    "final_stock": 2000,
    "final_stock_value": 2.90,  # month-3 purchase price for valuing ending inventory
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    months = d["months"]
    last = months[-1]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.T = pyo.Set(initialize=months, ordered=True)

    # Decision variables
    model.buy = pyo.Var(model.T, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.sell = pyo.Var(model.T, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.stock = pyo.Var(model.T, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
                          bounds=(0, d["capacity"]))
    model.cash = pyo.Var(model.T, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # Objective: maximize final cash + value of ending inventory - initial capital
    def obj_rule(m):
        return m.cash[last] + d["final_stock_value"] * m.stock[last] - d["initial_cash"]
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # Inventory balance: stock[t-1] + buy[t] - sell[t] = stock[t]
    def balance_rule(m, t):
        prev = d["initial_stock"] if t == months[0] else m.stock[t - 1]
        return prev + m.buy[t] - m.sell[t] == m.stock[t]
    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=balance_rule)

    # Sales limited to stock available at start of month (cannot sell same-month purchase)
    def sales_limit_rule(m, t):
        prev = d["initial_stock"] if t == months[0] else m.stock[t - 1]
        return m.sell[t] <= prev
    model.sales_limit = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=sales_limit_rule)

    # No sales in the first month (nothing purchased before month 1)
    def no_sale_first_rule(m):
        return m.sell[months[0]] == 0
    model.no_sale_first = pyo.Constraint(rule=no_sale_first_rule)

    # Cash balance: cash[t-1] - purchase_price*buy[t] + selling_price*sell[t] = cash[t]
    def cash_balance_rule(m, t):
        prev = d["initial_cash"] if t == months[0] else m.cash[t - 1]
        return (prev
                - d["purchase_price"][t] * m.buy[t]
                + d["selling_price"][t] * m.sell[t]
                == m.cash[t])
    model.cash_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=cash_balance_rule)

    # Cannot spend more cash than available at start of month (pay on delivery)
    def budget_rule(m, t):
        prev = d["initial_cash"] if t == months[0] else m.cash[t - 1]
        return d["purchase_price"][t] * m.buy[t] <= prev
    model.budget = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=budget_rule)

    # Final stock requirement
    def final_stock_rule(m):
        return m.stock[last] == d["final_stock"]
    model.final_stock = pyo.Constraint(rule=final_stock_rule)

    return model

DATA = {
    # "a warehouse with a capacity of 5000 units"
    "warehouse_capacity": 5000,
    # "On January 1st, the company has a stock of 1000 units of miscellaneous grain"
    "initial_stock": 1000,
    # "and a capital of 20000 yuan"
    "initial_capital": 20000,
    # "The company wants to have a stock of 2000 units at the end of the quarter"
    "final_stock_required": 2000,
    # Table 1-8 purchase prices (yuan/unit) for months 1, 2, 3
    "purchase_price": {1: 2.85, 2: 3.05, 3: 2.90},
    # Table 1-8 selling prices (yuan/unit) for months 1, 2, 3
    "selling_price": {1: 3.10, 2: 3.25, 3: 2.95},
    # Months of the quarter
    "months": [1, 2, 3],
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    months = d["months"]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # ----- Sets -------------------------------------------------------------
    model.T = pyo.Set(initialize=months, ordered=True)
    # inventory index includes month 0 (initial state)
    model.TI = pyo.Set(initialize=[0] + months, ordered=True)

    # ----- Variables --------------------------------------------------------
    # Units purchased in month t (arrive same month, paid on delivery)
    model.buy = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    # Units sold in month t (from previously purchased stock)
    model.sell = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    # Stock on hand at end of month t
    model.inv = pyo.Var(model.TI, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    # Cash on hand at end of month t (capital tracking for pay-on-delivery)
    model.cash = pyo.Var(model.TI, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # ----- Fix initial state (month 0) --------------------------------------
    model.inv[0].fix(d["initial_stock"])
    model.cash[0].fix(d["initial_capital"])

    # ----- Objective: maximise total profit over three months ---------------
    def obj_rule(m):
        revenue = sum(d["selling_price"][t] * m.sell[t] for t in m.T)
        cost = sum(d["purchase_price"][t] * m.buy[t] for t in m.T)
        return revenue - cost

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # ----- Warehouse capacity ----------------------------------------------
    def cap_rule(m, t):
        return m.inv[t] <= d["warehouse_capacity"]

    model.capacity = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=cap_rule)

    # ----- Inventory balance ------------------------------------------------
    def balance_rule(m, t):
        return m.inv[t] == m.inv[t - 1] + m.buy[t] - m.sell[t]

    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=balance_rule)

    # ----- "can only be sold in the following month" ------------------------
    # Sales in month t draw on stock available at the end of the previous month.
    def sell_limit_rule(m, t):
        return m.sell[t] <= m.inv[t - 1]

    model.sell_limit = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=sell_limit_rule)

    # ----- Cash balance: "paid upon delivery" -------------------------------
    def cash_rule(m, t):
        return m.cash[t] == (
            m.cash[t - 1]
            - d["purchase_price"][t] * m.buy[t]
            + d["selling_price"][t] * m.sell[t]
        )

    model.cash_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=cash_rule)

    # ----- Required ending stock --------------------------------------------
    model.final_stock = pyo.Constraint(
        expr=model.inv[months[-1]] == d["final_stock_required"]
    )

    return model

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "months": [1, 2, 3],
    "buy_price":  {1: 2.85, 2: 3.05, 3: 2.90},
    "sell_price": {1: 3.10, 2: 3.25, 3: 2.95},
    "init_stock": 1000,
    "init_capital": 20000,
    "capacity": 5000,
    "final_stock": 2000,
    "terminal_price": 2.95,  # month-3 selling price used to value leftover stock
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.T = pyo.RangeSet(min(d["months"]), max(d["months"]))
    # T0 includes the initial state (month 0) plus all months
    model.T0 = pyo.Set(initialize=range(min(d["months"]) - 1, max(d["months"]) + 1))

    # b[t]: units purchased in month t
    model.b = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # s[t]: units sold in month t
    model.s = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # I[t]: end-of-month inventory (index 0 = initial state)
    model.I = pyo.Var(model.T0, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
                      bounds=(0, d["capacity"]))

    # C[t]: end-of-month capital (index 0 = initial capital, fixed via constraint)
    model.C = pyo.Var(model.T0, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # Objective: maximize terminal capital plus value of remaining stock,
    # net of the initial capital constant.
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(
        expr=model.C[max(d["months"])]
             + d["terminal_price"] * model.I[max(d["months"])]
             - d["init_capital"],
        sense=pyo.maximize,
    )

    # Fix initial inventory and initial capital.
    model.init_inv = pyo.Constraint(
        expr=model.I[min(d["months"]) - 1] == d["init_stock"]
    )
    model.init_cap = pyo.Constraint(
        expr=model.C[min(d["months"]) - 1] == d["init_capital"]
    )

    # Inventory balance: I[t] = I[t-1] + b[t] - s[t]
    def inv_balance_rule(m, t):
        return m.I[t] == m.I[t - 1] + m.b[t] - m.s[t]
    model.inv_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=inv_balance_rule)

    # Cash balance: C[t] = C[t-1] + sell_price[t]*s[t] - buy_price[t]*b[t]
    # (payment upon delivery => purchase cost hits cash in the same month)
    def cash_balance_rule(m, t):
        return (m.C[t] == m.C[t - 1]
                + d["sell_price"][t] * m.s[t]
                - d["buy_price"][t] * m.b[t])
    model.cash_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=cash_balance_rule)

    # Sales only from grain acquired in earlier months:
    #   cumulative sales by end of month t <= init_stock + cumulative purchases through t-1
    def sale_avail_rule(m, t):
        return (sum(m.s[k] for k in m.T if k <= t)
                <= d["init_stock"] + sum(m.b[k] for k in m.T if k <= t - 1))
    model.sale_avail = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=sale_avail_rule)

    # Terminal inventory requirement
    model.final_inv = pyo.Constraint(
        expr=model.I[max(d["months"])] == d["final_stock"]
    )

    return model


if __name__ == "__main__":
    m = build_model()
    m.pprint()

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "months": [1, 2, 3],
    "purchase_price": {1: 2.85, 2: 3.05, 3: 2.90},
    "selling_price": {1: 3.10, 2: 3.25, 3: 2.95},
    "warehouse_capacity": 5000,
    "initial_stock": 1000,
    "initial_cash": 20000,
    "final_stock": 2000,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    months = d["months"]
    first = months[0]
    last = months[-1]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.T = pyo.Set(initialize=months, ordered=True)

    # Decision variables
    model.buy = pyo.Var(model.T, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.sell = pyo.Var(model.T, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.stock = pyo.Var(
        model.T,
        domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
        bounds=(0, d["warehouse_capacity"]),
    )
    model.cash = pyo.Var(model.T, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # Objective: maximize ending capital (profit = cash[last] - initial_cash)
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(expr=model.cash[last], sense=pyo.maximize)

    # Inventory balance: stock[t-1] + buy[t] - sell[t] = stock[t]
    def inventory_balance_rule(m, t):
        prev_stock = d["initial_stock"] if t == first else m.stock[t - 1]
        return prev_stock + m.buy[t] - m.sell[t] == m.stock[t]

    model.inventory_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=inventory_balance_rule)

    # Sales can only come from stock available at start of month
    def sales_timing_rule(m, t):
        prev_stock = d["initial_stock"] if t == first else m.stock[t - 1]
        return m.sell[t] <= prev_stock

    model.sales_timing = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=sales_timing_rule)

    # Final stock requirement
    model.final_stock = pyo.Constraint(
        expr=model.stock[last] == d["final_stock"]
    )

    # Cash balance: cash[t] = cash[t-1] - purchase_cost + sales_revenue
    def cash_balance_rule(m, t):
        prev_cash = d["initial_cash"] if t == first else m.cash[t - 1]
        return (
            m.cash[t]
            == prev_cash
            - d["purchase_price"][t] * m.buy[t]
            + d["selling_price"][t] * m.sell[t]
        )

    model.cash_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=cash_balance_rule)

    return model

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "months": [1, 2, 3],
    "purchase_price": {1: 2.85, 2: 3.05, 3: 2.90},
    "selling_price":  {1: 3.10, 2: 3.25, 3: 2.95},
    "warehouse_capacity": 5000,   # units
    "initial_stock": 1000,        # units on Jan 1
    "initial_capital": 20000,     # yuan on Jan 1
    "final_stock": 2000,          # required stock at end of quarter
    "big_m": 5000,                # not needed per se; kept for clarity if bounds used
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    m = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # Index set: months 1,2,3
    m.T = pyo.Set(initialize=d["months"], ordered=True)

    # Time points 0..3 for inventory / cash states
    m.T0 = pyo.Set(initialize=[0, 1, 2, 3], ordered=True)

    # --- Variables ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Units purchased in month t
    m.x = pyo.Var(m.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # Units sold in month t
    m.s = pyo.Var(m.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # Inventory at end of month t (t in 0..3)
    m.I = pyo.Var(m.T0, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
                  bounds=(0, d["warehouse_capacity"]))

    # Capital at end of month t (t in 0..3)
    m.C = pyo.Var(m.T0, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # --- Fix initial states ------------------------------------------------
    m.I[0].fix(d["initial_stock"])
    m.C[0].fix(d["initial_capital"])

    # --- Objective (maximize final capital minus initial capital) ----------
    m.obj = pyo.Objective(expr=m.C[max(d["months"])] - d["initial_capital"],
                          sense=pyo.maximize)

    # --- Constraints -------------------------------------------------------

    # Inventory balance: I[t] = I[t-1] + x[t] - s[t]   (>= equality)
    def inv_balance_rule(mm, t):
        return mm.I[t] == mm.I[t - 1] + mm.x[t] - mm.s[t]
    m.inv_balance = pyo.Constraint(m.T, rule=inv_balance_rule)

    # Cash balance: C[t] = C[t-1] - purchase_cost + revenue
    def cash_balance_rule(mm, t):
        return (mm.C[t] == mm.C[t - 1]
                - d["purchase_price"][t] * mm.x[t]
                + d["selling_price"][t] * mm.s[t])
    m.cash_balance = pyo.Constraint(m.T, rule=cash_balance_rule)

    # Pay-upon-delivery: purchase outlay in month t <= cash entering month t
    def cash_limit_rule(mm, t):
        return d["purchase_price"][t] * mm.x[t] <= mm.C[t - 1]
    m.cash_limit = pyo.Constraint(m.T, rule=cash_limit_rule)

    # Sales-timing: goods bought in month t can only be sold from month t+1 on.
    # Equivalently, cumulative sales up to month t <= stock available before month t.
    # s[1] <= I[0]
    m.sales_avail_1 = pyo.Constraint(
        expr=m.s[1] <= d["initial_stock"])
    # s[2] <= I[0] + x[1]
    m.sales_avail_2 = pyo.Constraint(
        expr=m.s[2] <= d["initial_stock"] + m.x[1])
    # s[3] <= I[0] + x[1] + x[2]
    m.sales_avail_3 = pyo.Constraint(
        expr=m.s[3] <= d["initial_stock"] + m.x[1] + m.x[2])

    # Warehouse capacity already enforced via I bounds; also cap purchases +
    # stock indirectly through inventory bound above.

    # Final stock requirement: I[3] = 2000
    m.final_stock = pyo.Constraint(
        expr=m.I[max(d["months"])] == d["final_stock"])

    return m


if __name__ == "__main__":
    model = build_model()
    model.pprint()

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "months_purchase": [1, 2, 3],
    "months_sale": [2, 3],
    "purchase_price": {1: 2.85, 2: 3.05, 3: 2.90},
    "selling_price": {1: 3.10, 2: 3.25, 3: 2.95},
    "warehouse_capacity": 5000,
    "initial_stock": 1000,
    "initial_cash": 20000,
    "final_stock_required": 2000,
    "bigM": 1e6,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    m = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    m.T = pyo.Set(initialize=d["months_purchase"], ordered=True)
    m.TS = pyo.Set(initialize=d["months_sale"], ordered=True)

    m.buy = pyo.Var(m.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    m.sell = pyo.Var(m.TS, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    m.stock = pyo.Var(m.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
                      bounds=(0, d["warehouse_capacity"]))
    m.cash = pyo.Var(m.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # Objective: maximize revenue - purchase cost
    def rule_obj(m):
        rev = sum(m.sell[t] * d["selling_price"][t] for t in m.TS)
        cost = sum(m.buy[t] * d["purchase_price"][t] for t in m.T)
        return rev - cost

    m.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=rule_obj, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # Warehouse capacity: ending stock each month <= capacity
    def rule_capacity(m, t):
        return m.stock[t] <= d["warehouse_capacity"]

    m.capacity = pyo.Constraint(m.T, rule=rule_capacity)

    # Inventory balance: stock_t = stock_{t-1} + buy_t - sell_t (sell only in TS)
    def rule_stock(m, t):
        prev = d["initial_stock"] if t == d["months_purchase"][0] else m.stock[t - 1]
        sold = m.sell[t] if t in d["months_sale"] else 0
        return m.stock[t] == prev + m.buy[t] - sold

    m.stock_balance = pyo.Constraint(m.T, rule=rule_stock)

    # Cannot sell in month 1 (bought same month cannot be sold same month)
    m.no_sale_month1 = pyo.Constraint(
        expr=m.sell[d["months_sale"][0]] <= d["initial_stock"]
    )

    # Sales in month t limited by previous month's stock (arrives same month, sold next)
    def rule_sale_limit(m, t):
        return m.sell[t] <= m.stock[t - 1]

    m.sale_limit = pyo.Constraint(m.TS, rule=rule_sale_limit)

    # Cash flow: pay on delivery; cash evolves with purchases (out) and sales (in)
    def rule_cash(m, t):
        prev = d["initial_cash"] if t == d["months_purchase"][0] else m.cash[t - 1]
        sold = m.sell[t] if t in d["months_sale"] else 0
        return m.cash[t] == prev - m.buy[t] * d["purchase_price"][t] + sold * d["selling_price"][t]

    m.cash_balance = pyo.Constraint(m.T, rule=rule_cash)

    # Pay-on-delivery: purchases must be financed by available capital
    def rule_purchase_afford(m, t):
        prev = d["initial_cash"] if t == d["months_purchase"][0] else m.cash[t - 1]
        sold = m.sell[t] if t in d["months_sale"] else 0
        return m.buy[t] * d["purchase_price"][t] <= prev + sold * d["selling_price"][t]

    m.afford = pyo.Constraint(m.T, rule=rule_purchase_afford)

    # Final required stock at end of quarter
    m.final_stock = pyo.Constraint(
        expr=m.stock[d["months_purchase"][-1]] == d["final_stock_required"]
    )

    return m

import pyomo.environ as pyo

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DATA: every numeric constant from the problem statement
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
DATA = {
    "months": [1, 2, 3],
    "warehouse_capacity": 5000,   # units
    "initial_stock": 1000,        # units on Jan 1
    "initial_capital": 20000,     # yuan on Jan 1
    "final_stock_target": 2000,   # units required at end of quarter
    "purchase_price": {1: 2.85, 2: 3.05, 3: 2.90},  # yuan/unit
    "selling_price": {1: 3.10, 2: 3.25, 3: 2.95},   # yuan/unit
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Decision variables
#   buy[t]   >= 0  units purchased in month t
#   sell[t]  >= 0  units sold in month t
#   stock[t] >= 0  units of inventory held at end of month t
#   cash[t]  >= 0  cash balance at end of month t
#
# Objective (maximize): total net profit over the quarter
#   sum_t selling_price[t]*sell[t] - sum_t purchase_price[t]*buy[t]
#
# Constraints
#   (1) Inventory balance each month:
#       stock[t-1] + buy[t] - sell[t] = stock[t]
#   (2) Warehouse capacity each month: stock[t] <= warehouse_capacity
#   (3) Final inventory requirement: stock[3] = final_stock_target
#   (4) Cash balance each month (payment on delivery, sales receipts):
#       cash[t-1] + selling_price[t]*sell[t] - purchase_price[t]*buy[t] = cash[t]
#   (5) Sales in month t cannot exceed stock available at start of month t
#       (grain bought in month t can only be sold from the following month):
#       sell[t] <= stock[t-1]
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    months = d["months"]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.T = pyo.Set(initialize=months, ordered=True)

    model.buy = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.sell = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.stock = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
                          bounds=(0, d["warehouse_capacity"]))
    model.cash = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # Objective: maximize net profit
    def obj_rule(m):
        revenue = sum(d["selling_price"][t] * m.sell[t] for t in m.T)
        cost = sum(d["purchase_price"][t] * m.buy[t] for t in m.T)
        return revenue - cost

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # (1) Inventory balance
    def stock_balance_rule(m, t):
        prev_stock = d["initial_stock"] if t == months[0] else m.stock[t - 1]
        return prev_stock + m.buy[t] - m.sell[t] == m.stock[t]

    model.stock_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=stock_balance_rule)

    # (2) Warehouse capacity
    def capacity_rule(m, t):
        return m.stock[t] <= d["warehouse_capacity"]

    model.capacity = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=capacity_rule)

    # (3) Final inventory requirement
    def final_stock_rule(m):
        return m.stock[months[-1]] == d["final_stock_target"]

    model.final_stock = pyo.Constraint(rule=final_stock_rule)

    # (4) Cash balance
    def cash_balance_rule(m, t):
        prev_cash = d["initial_capital"] if t == months[0] else m.cash[t - 1]
        inflow = d["selling_price"][t] * m.sell[t]
        outflow = d["purchase_price"][t] * m.buy[t]
        return prev_cash + inflow - outflow == m.cash[t]

    model.cash_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=cash_balance_rule)

    # (5) Sales limited to stock available at start of month
    def sales_limit_rule(m, t):
        prev_stock = d["initial_stock"] if t == months[0] else m.stock[t - 1]
        return m.sell[t] <= prev_stock

    model.sales_limit = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=sales_limit_rule)

    return model

DATA = {
    # "warehouse with a capacity of 5000 units"
    "warehouse_capacity": 5000,
    # "a stock of 1000 units of miscellaneous grain"
    "initial_stock": 1000,
    # "a capital of 20000 yuan"
    "initial_capital": 20000,
    # Table 1-8: Purchase Price (yuan/unit) per month (1-indexed)
    "purchase_price": {1: 2.85, 2: 3.05, 3: 2.90},
    # Table 1-8: Selling Price (yuan/unit) per month (1-indexed)
    "selling_price": {1: 3.10, 2: 3.25, 3: 2.95},
    # "have a stock of 2000 units at the end of the quarter"
    "final_stock_target": 2000,
    # Months in the first quarter
    "months": [1, 2, 3],
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # --- Sets ---
    model.T = pyo.Set(initialize=d["months"], ordered=True)

    # --- Variables ---
    # Units purchased in month t
    model.buy = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    # Units sold in month t
    model.sell = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    # Stock at end of month t (bounded by warehouse capacity)
    model.stock = pyo.Var(
        model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=(0, d["warehouse_capacity"])
    )
    # Capital at end of month t
    model.cash = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # --- Objective: maximize final capital (= total profit + initial capital) ---
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(expr=model.cash[3], sense=pyo.maximize)

    # --- Constraints ---

    # Stock balance for month 1: stock[1] = initial_stock + buy[1] - sell[1]
    def stock_balance_first_rule(m):
        return m.stock[1] == d["initial_stock"] + m.buy[1] - m.sell[1]

    model.stock_balance_first = pyo.Constraint(rule=stock_balance_first_rule)

    # Stock balance for months 2,3: stock[t] = stock[t-1] + buy[t] - sell[t]
    def stock_balance_rule(m, t):
        if t == 1:
            return pyo.Constraint.Skip
        return m.stock[t] == m.stock[t - 1] + m.buy[t] - m.sell[t]

    model.stock_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=stock_balance_rule)

    # Sales can only come from previous month's stock ("sold in the following month").
    def sell_limit_first_rule(m):
        return m.sell[1] <= d["initial_stock"]

    model.sell_limit_first = pyo.Constraint(rule=sell_limit_first_rule)

    def sell_limit_rule(m, t):
        if t == 1:
            return pyo.Constraint.Skip
        return m.sell[t] <= m.stock[t - 1]

    model.sell_limit = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=sell_limit_rule)

    # Cash balance for month 1: cash[1] = initial_capital - buy_cost + sell_revenue
    def cash_balance_first_rule(m):
        return (
            m.cash[1]
            == d["initial_capital"]
            - d["purchase_price"][1] * m.buy[1]
            + d["selling_price"][1] * m.sell[1]
        )

    model.cash_balance_first = pyo.Constraint(rule=cash_balance_first_rule)

    # Cash balance for months 2,3
    def cash_balance_rule(m, t):
        if t == 1:
            return pyo.Constraint.Skip
        return (
            m.cash[t]
            == m.cash[t - 1]
            - d["purchase_price"][t] * m.buy[t]
            + d["selling_price"][t] * m.sell[t]
        )

    model.cash_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=cash_balance_rule)

    # Final stock requirement: at least 2000 units at end of quarter
    def final_stock_rule(m):
        return m.stock[3] >= d["final_stock_target"]

    model.final_stock = pyo.Constraint(rule=final_stock_rule)

    return model

import pyomo.environ as pyo

# =============================================================================
# PROBLEM: Wholesale grain trading over a 3-month quarter
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Decision variables
#   buy[t]  : units of grain purchased in month t (t = 1,2,3), NonNegativeReals
#   sell[t] : units of grain sold in month t (t = 1,2,3), NonNegativeReals
#   stock[t]: units of grain held in inventory at END of month t, NonNegativeReals
#   cash[t] : capital (yuan) held at END of month t, NonNegativeReals
#
# Objective (maximize total profit over the quarter):
#   Profit = final cash - initial cash
#   (equivalently maximize cash[3], since cash[0] is a constant)
#
# Constraints (numbered, with source sentence):
#   (1) Inventory balance: stock[t-1] + buy[t] - sell[t] = stock[t]
#       "The purchased grain arrives in the same month but can only be sold
#        in the following month" -> grain bought in month t is available for
#        sale from month t+1 onward; grain sold in month t comes from stock
#        accumulated before month t.
#   (2) Sales limited to stock available at start of month (cannot sell what
#       you don't have): sell[t] <= stock[t-1]
#   (3) Warehouse capacity: stock[t] <= 5000
#       "warehouse with a capacity of 5000 units"
#   (4) Cash balance: cash[t-1] - buy[t]*price_buy[t] + sell[t]*price_sell[t]
#       = cash[t]
#       "it is required to be paid upon delivery" (purchases paid in month of
#        purchase); sales revenue received in month of sale.
#   (5) Cannot spend more cash than available: buy[t]*price_buy[t] <= cash[t-1]
#   (6) Initial conditions: stock[0] = 1000, cash[0] = 20000
#       "On January 1st, the company has a stock of 1000 units ... and a
#        capital of 20000 yuan"
#   (7) Final stock requirement: stock[3] = 2000
#       "The company wants to have a stock of 2000 units at the end of the
#        quarter"
# =============================================================================

DATA = {
    "months": [1, 2, 3],
    "initial_stock": 1000,
    "initial_cash": 20000,
    "final_stock": 2000,
    "warehouse_capacity": 5000,
    "purchase_price": {1: 2.85, 2: 3.05, 3: 2.90},
    "selling_price": {1: 3.10, 2: 3.25, 3: 2.95},
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    months = d["months"]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Sets
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    model.T = pyo.Set(initialize=months, ordered=True)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Variables
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    model.buy = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.sell = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.stock = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.cash = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Objective: maximize final cash (profit = final cash - initial cash)
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(
        expr=model.cash[months[-1]],
        sense=pyo.maximize,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # (1) Inventory balance
    #     stock[t-1] + buy[t] - sell[t] = stock[t]
    #     For t = first month, stock[t-1] = initial_stock.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def inventory_balance_rule(m, t):
        prev_stock = d["initial_stock"] if t == months[0] else m.stock[t - 1]
        return prev_stock + m.buy[t] - m.sell[t] == m.stock[t]

    model.inventory_balance = pyo.Constraint(
        model.T, rule=inventory_balance_rule
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # (2) Sales limited to stock available at start of month
    #     sell[t] <= stock[t-1]
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def sales_limit_rule(m, t):
        prev_stock = d["initial_stock"] if t == months[0] else m.stock[t - 1]
        return m.sell[t] <= prev_stock

    model.sales_limit = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=sales_limit_rule)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # (3) Warehouse capacity
    #     stock[t] <= 5000
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def capacity_rule(m, t):
        return m.stock[t] <= d["warehouse_capacity"]

    model.capacity = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=capacity_rule)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # (4) Cash balance
    #     cash[t-1] - buy[t]*purchase_price[t] + sell[t]*selling_price[t]
    #         = cash[t]
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def cash_balance_rule(m, t):
        prev_cash = d["initial_cash"] if t == months[0] else m.cash[t - 1]
        return (
            prev_cash
            - m.buy[t] * d["purchase_price"][t]
            + m.sell[t] * d["selling_price"][t]
            == m.cash[t]
        )

    model.cash_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=cash_balance_rule)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # (5) Cannot spend more cash than available
    #     buy[t]*purchase_price[t] <= cash[t-1]
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def cash_limit_rule(m, t):
        prev_cash = d["initial_cash"] if t == months[0] else m.cash[t - 1]
        return m.buy[t] * d["purchase_price"][t] <= prev_cash

    model.cash_limit = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=cash_limit_rule)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # (7) Final stock requirement
    #     stock[3] = 2000
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    model.final_stock = pyo.Constraint(
        expr=model.stock[months[-1]] == d["final_stock"]
    )

    return model

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "months": [1, 2, 3],
    "purchase_price": {1: 2.85, 2: 3.05, 3: 2.90},
    "selling_price":  {1: 3.10, 2: 3.25, 3: 2.95},
    "warehouse_capacity": 5000,
    "initial_stock": 1000,
    "initial_cash": 20000,
    "terminal_stock": 2000,
    "cash_big_m": 1000000,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()
    model.T = pyo.Set(initialize=d["months"], ordered=True)
    model.T0 = pyo.Set(initialize=[0] + list(d["months"]), ordered=True)

    # Decision variables
    model.buy = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.sell = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.stock = pyo.Var(model.T0, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
                          bounds=(0, d["warehouse_capacity"]))
    model.cash = pyo.Var(model.T0, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
                         bounds=(0, d["cash_big_m"]))

    # Initial conditions
    model.stock[0].fix(d["initial_stock"])
    model.cash[0].fix(d["initial_cash"])

    # No sales possible in month 1 (bought grain only sellable next month)
    model.sell[1].fix(0)

    # Inventory balance: stock[t] = stock[t-1] + buy[t] - sell[t]
    def stock_balance_rule(m, t):
        prev = 0 if t == 1 else t - 1
        return m.stock[t] == m.stock[prev] + m.buy[t] - m.sell[t]
    model.stock_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=stock_balance_rule)

    # Grain sold in month t must come from stock held at start of t
    def sell_available_rule(m, t):
        prev = 0 if t == 1 else t - 1
        return m.sell[t] <= m.stock[prev]
    model.sell_available = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=sell_available_rule)

    # Cash balance: cash[t] = cash[t-1] - price_buy*buy[t] + price_sell*sell[t]
    def cash_balance_rule(m, t):
        prev = 0 if t == 1 else t - 1
        return (m.cash[t] == m.cash[prev]
                - d["purchase_price"][t] * m.buy[t]
                + d["selling_price"][t] * m.sell[t])
    model.cash_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=cash_balance_rule)

    # Warehouse capacity each month-end
    def capacity_rule(m, t):
        return m.stock[t] <= d["warehouse_capacity"]
    model.capacity = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=capacity_rule)

    # Terminal stock requirement at end of month 3
    model.terminal = pyo.Constraint(
        expr=model.stock[3] == d["terminal_stock"]
    )

    # Objective: maximize terminal capital (total profit)
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(expr=model.cash[3], sense=pyo.maximize)

    return model
